incidents.name: Incident on 2011-01-28 22:18:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2011-01-28 22:18:00 - Experiencing high DB load currently. We're on it.
  • 2011-01-28 23:02:00 - The DB spike cause has been fixed. All systems are back to normal.

incidents.name: Incident on 2011-01-25 06:55:00 UTC
incidents.message: • 2011-01-25 06:55:00 - Maintenance is finished and the site is fully operational again.

incidents.name: Incident on 2011-01-25 06:00:00 UTC
incidents.message: • 2011-01-25 06:00:00 - Maintenance starting now.

incidents.name: Incident on 2011-01-25 05:50:00 UTC
incidents.message: • 2011-01-25 05:50:00 - Maintenance starting in ten minutes. http://bit.ly/fwseGo

incidents.name: Incident on 2011-01-24 19:14:00 UTC
incidents.message: • 2011-01-24 19:14:00 - We will be having scheduled maintenance tonight from 22:00 - 22:20 PST during which github.com may be unavailable for a short period of time. GitHub Pages and GitHub Jobs will be unaffected.

incidents.name: Incident on 2011-01-20 15:57:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2011-01-20 15:57:00 - We're seeing some sporadic errors on the site due to frontend instability. Working on a solution.
  • 2011-01-20 16:09:00 - Heavy load on frontends due to request volume is causing problems. Will keep you updated.
  • 2011-01-20 16:42:00 - Source of traffic spike has been identified and neutralized. All systems should be back to normal.

incidents.name: Incident on 2011-01-16 21:06:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2011-01-16 21:06:00 - One of the file servers is offline. Working hard to fix it up.
  • 2011-01-16 21:13:00 - File server is back online.

incidents.name: Incident on 2011-01-12 23:16:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2011-01-12 23:16:00 - One of our file servers is acting up. Looking into it.
  • 2011-01-12 23:24:00 - File server is back online.

incidents.name: Incident on 2011-01-12 19:16:00 UTC
incidents.message: • 2011-01-12 19:16:00 - Just had a temporary job queue backlog. The problem is fixed and the queue is clearing out now.

incidents.name: Incident on 2011-01-08 05:34:00 UTC
incidents.message: • 2011-01-08 05:34:00 - All done! We work fast. =)

incidents.name: Incident on 2011-01-08 05:30:00 UTC
incidents.message: • 2011-01-08 05:30:00 - Solr maintenance starting now. Searches may be temporarily unavailable across the site.

incidents.name: Incident on 2011-01-04 21:12:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2011-01-04 21:12:00 - One of our file servers is acting up, we're working on the issue.
  • 2011-01-04 21:13:00 - We've upgraded the kernel on the misbehaving fileserver and everything should be back to normal. We're keeping a close eye on everything.

incidents.name: Incident on 2011-01-04 16:10:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2011-01-04 16:10:00 - One of the file servers failed over temporarily. Working on it...
  • 2011-01-04 17:40:00 - The HA/fencing system on the downed file server is screwed up. Working hard to restore order to the universe.
  • 2011-01-04 18:00:00 - The file server is back online in manual failover mode until we can figure out why it freaked. Most repos are now accessible. Will update when all repos are back online.
  • 2011-01-04 18:14:00 - The site may show 404s or empty repos for the partitions that are still not online. Don't worry there is no data loss. Looking to make those errors less scary.
  • 2011-01-04 20:13:31 - All repos are back online. We will be investigating root cause and solutions to prevent this from happening again. Thanks for your patience, everyone.

incidents.name: Incident on 2011-01-04 00:26:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2011-01-04 00:26:00 - Still seeing intermittent timeouts from the load balancer. Working on it.
  • 2011-01-04 03:14:00 - We've tracked down the intermittent SSH connection issues seen earlier today and feel that the service is back to a fully operational state. We'll be writing up a post-mortem on the issues soon.

incidents.name: Incident on 2011-01-03 22:42:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2011-01-03 22:42:00 - We seem to be having some intermittent SSH problems. Working on it.
  • 2011-01-03 23:00:00 - SSH access is restored.

incidents.name: Incident on 2011-01-03 16:39:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2011-01-03 16:39:00 - Intermittent errors fetching/pushing and on the site due to high traffic. We're investigating.
  • 2011-01-03 18:03:00 - One of the load balancers failed, surfacing some problems with our internal DNS setup. The site is responding, although reports of intermittent failures continue. We're working to correct the issue for everyone.
  • 2011-01-03 19:12:00 - We identified a problem with our load balancer's routing after the load balancer failure earlier this morning. Everything is looking good right now but we're keeping a close eye on things to make sure everything is back to normal.\r\n\r\nWe will update a
  • 2011-01-03 19:56:00 - Everything is back and functional. We're sorry for the issues you all experienced this morning. Expect a post-mortem on the blog in the next few days.

incidents.name: Incident on 2010-12-30 17:19:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2010-12-30 17:19:00 - Search and jobs.github.com is down. We're looking into it.
  • 2010-12-30 18:29:00 - Search & Jobs is back. The gist index had to be momentarily dropped - we'll be reindexing gists throughout the day.

incidents.name: Incident on 2010-12-25 20:56:03 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2010-12-25 20:56:03 - A number of machines are under high load leading to 500s. We're investigating.
  • 2010-12-25 21:36:00 - Load is back under control on the frontend machines. All systems go.

incidents.name: Incident on 2010-12-19 22:40:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2010-12-19 22:40:00 - One of the file servers is down. Will be back shortly.
  • 2010-12-19 22:43:00 - Ok, it's back. Sorry about that.

incidents.name: Incident on 2010-12-15 18:10:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2010-12-15 18:10:00 - One of the file servers is failing over due to high load. We're looking into it.\r\n
  • 2010-12-15 21:46:00 - Everything operating normally

incidents.name: Incident on 2010-12-13 10:54:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2010-12-13 10:54:00 - One of the file server is failing over due to high load. We're looking into it.
  • 2010-12-13 11:00:00 - Everything operating normally

incidents.name: Incident on 2010-12-02 21:47:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2010-12-02 21:47:00 - Site is unavailable. We're researching the issue.
  • 2010-12-02 21:54:00 - Heartbeat misfired and took the database offline. We're investigating to make sure it doesn't happen again.

incidents.name: Incident on 2010-11-23 03:06:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2010-11-23 03:06:00 - We have a few thousand jobs queued up due to a database migration that's underway. We're about halfway through it and expect these jobs to run quickly after the migration completes. We appreciate your patience here!
  • 2010-11-23 04:13:00 - All systems go.

incidents.name: Incident on 2010-11-14 21:30:00 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2010-11-14 21:30:00 - And we're back down.
  • 2010-11-14 22:53:00 - The site and git access is restored.\r\n\r\nDashboard and user profile event data was held back to speed up database restore time and get the site back online. We plan to restore event history over the next few days.

incidents.name: Incident on 2010-11-14 20:15:52 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2010-11-14 20:15:52 - The site and git access is unavailable due to a database failure. We're researching the issue.
  • 2010-11-14 21:05:00 - We've restored a GitHub Pages config backup from a few days ago. Most Pages sites should now be accessible.\r\n\r\nWork continues on bringing the rest of the site back.
  • 2010-11-14 21:23:00 - And we're back after a database restore.

incidents.name: Incident on 2010-11-05 19:09:03 UTC
incidents.message:
• 2010-11-05 19:09:03 - GitHub Pages is down. We're investigating the cause.
  • 2010-11-05 19:09:39 - And it's back up after rebooting the Pages webserver. The Github.com frontend and Git data were not affected at all.
